description:
`supports_acl('duckdb')` currently returns `True` (or a non-False value)
because 'duckdb' is missing from the `no_acl` frozenset in
`benchbox/core/metadata_primitives/ddl.py:583`. DuckDB is a Tier 4
platform that does not support ACL / GRANT/REVOKE semantics, consistent
with its classification in `catalog/queries.yaml:1435-1438`.

Surfaced as a pending work item (w2) in the DONE file for
`reconcile-docs-review-code-followups` (completed 2026-04-16). Items w1
(HashAlgorithm Literal narrowing) and w3 (stream cursor call sites) were
completed; w2 was never executed.

The fix is a one-line change. The anti_pattern note from the DONE file
specifies: do NOT change supports_acl_introspection / role_hierarchy /
column_grants for DuckDB — those already correctly return False — only the
`no_acl` set needs 'duckdb' added.

anti_patterns.instead: only the no_acl set needs updating

preserves.behavior: All other platform ACL classifications are unaffected
supports_acl_introspection('duckdb'), role_hierarchy('duckdb'), and column_grants('duckdb') remain unchanged (already return False correctly)

prior_art.concept: benchbox/core/metadata_primitives/ddl.py:583 — add 'duckdb' to the no_acl set here
catalog/queries.yaml:1435-1438 — DuckDB Tier 4 classification; no ACL support
reconcile-docs-review-code-followups DONE file — w2 was the missed work item

scope_rules.path_glob: tests/ (only if a test encodes the buggy True return value)

verifications.command: python -c "from benchbox.core.metadata_primitives.ddl import supports_acl; assert supports_acl('duckdb') is False, f'got {supports_acl(\"duckdb\")}'" && echo OK
verifications.description: supports_acl('duckdb') returns False after the fix

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -k metadata_primitives -m fast -q

work_units.notes:
grep -n 'no_acl' benchbox/core/metadata_primitives/ddl.py
Confirm 'duckdb' is absent from the set. Also verify:
  python -c "from benchbox.core.metadata_primitives.ddl import supports_acl; print(supports_acl('duckdb'))"
Should print True or raise; target is False after the fix.
work_units.summary: Confirm supports_acl('duckdb') still returns a non-False value at the cited line

work_units.notes:
One-line change: add 'duckdb' to the no_acl frozenset.
Do NOT touch supports_acl_introspection, role_hierarchy, or column_grants
— those already return False for DuckDB and are correct.
work_units.summary: Add 'duckdb' to the no_acl set in ddl.py:583

work_units.notes:
uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -k metadata_primitives -m fast -q
If any test asserts supports_acl('duckdb') is True, that test was
encoding the bug — update it to assert False.
work_units.summary: Run metadata_primitives tests; update any test that encodes the old True return value
